detail.body:
## Motivation

An EAGLE3 draft that declares **both** `tie_word_embeddings: true` and a reduced `draft_vocab_size` loads the wrong output head, silently.

`AngelSlim/Qwen3-1.7B_eagle3` (target `Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B`) declares `draft_vocab_size: 32000` against `vocab_size: 151936` and ships its own 32000-row `lm_head.weight`. But `llama_eagle3.py` and `kimi_k25_eagle3.py` both checked `tie_word_embeddings` **before** `draft_vocab_size`, so the tied branch won and `draft_vocab_size` was never consulted. `lm_head` became the 151936-row target embedding while the `LogitsProcessor` was still built for 32000, so it silently truncated the logits (`logits[:, :32000]`) and the trained head was dropped by name-matching (with `lm_head is embed_tokens`, `named_parameters()` dedupes the alias).

Result: `spec_accept_rate = 0.0`, `accept_length ≈ 1.0`. No error, no warning — it reads as "the draft model is bad".

Related but distinct: #42094 fixes the same class of bug in `qwen3_5_mtp.py`, at runtime. This one is at load time, needs no `--speculative-token-map`, and fails silently rather than crashing.

## Modifications

Consult `draft_vocab_size` **first**; the tied embedding is only a fallback:

```python
draft_vocab_size = getattr(config, "draft_vocab_size", None)
if draft_vocab_size is not None:
    self.lm_head = ParallelLMHead(draft_vocab_size, ...)
elif config.tie_word_embeddings:
    self.lm_head = self.model.embed_tokens
else:
    self.load_lm_head_from_target = True
```

Only the `draft_vocab_size` set + `tie=True` case changes behavior; the other three rows are unchanged. `getattr` rather than `config.draft_vocab_size` because the latter raises `AttributeError` when the key is absent, and it is now read first.

## Accuracy Tests

H100, `Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B` + `AngelSlim/Qwen3-1.7B_eagle3`, EAGLE3, K=3, greedy:

| | `spec_accept_rate` | drafts accepted |
|---|---|---|
| before | 0.0000 | 0 / 1512 (8 prompts) |
| after | 0.1969 | 189 / 960 |

Before, **zero** drafts were accepted on any prompt; after, every prompt accepts (0.095–0.378).

Added `test/registered/unit/spec/test_eagle3_reduced_vocab_lm_head.py` — a CPU test over all four cases, non-vacuous (3 of 4 fail against the pre-fix code).

## Checklist

- [x] [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit)
- [x] [Add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests)
- [x] [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations) — n/a, no user-facing docs change
- [x] [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed)
- [x] [Code style guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance)

+# ==============================================================================
+"""EAGLE3 draft lm_head resolution for reduced/untied/tied vocabularies.
+
+A draft checkpoint that declares *both* ``tie_word_embeddings: true`` and a
+reduced ``draft_vocab_size`` ships its own ``lm_head.weight``. Resolving the
+tied embedding first used to bind the full-size target embedding as the draft
+head while the logits processor still used the reduced vocab; the processor
+silently truncated the logits and acceptance collapsed to ~0. These tests pin
+the resolution order so ``llama_eagle3`` and ``kimi_k25_eagle3`` cannot
+re-diverge.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+
+from transformers import LlamaConfig
+
+from sglang.srt.models.llama_eagle3 import LlamaForCausalLMEagle3
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_parallel
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import published_topology
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=8, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+VOCAB_SIZE = 151936
+DRAFT_VOCAB_SIZE = 32000
+
+
+def _config(**overrides):
+    base = dict(
+        vocab_size=VOCAB_SIZE,
+        hidden_size=64,
+        intermediate_size=128,
+        num_hidden_layers=1,
+        num_attention_heads=2,
+        num_key_value_heads=2,
+        rms_norm_eps=1e-5,
+        max_position_embeddings=128,
+    )
+    base.update(overrides)
+    return LlamaConfig(**base)
+
+
+class TestLlamaEagle3HeadResolution(unittest.TestCase):
+    """The four-row resolution matrix, end to end on the real draft model."""
+
+    def _build(self, **overrides):
+        config = _config(**overrides)
+        topology = published_topology(tp_size=1, pp_size=1)
+        topology.__enter__()
+        try:
+            with get_parallel().override(pp_group=None):
+                return LlamaForCausalLMEagle3(config)
+        finally:
+            topology.__exit__(None, None, None)
+
+    def test_reduced_vocab_wins_over_tied_embedding(self):
+        # The bug: tie=True previously bound the full-size embed_tokens as the
+        # head while the logits processor used the reduced vocab.
+        model = self._build(tie_word_embeddings=True, draft_vocab_size=DRAFT_VOCAB_SIZE)
+        self.assertIsNot(model.lm_head, model.model.embed_tokens)
+        self.assertEqual(model.lm_head.weight.shape[0], DRAFT_VOCAB_SIZE)
+        self.assertEqual(model.logits_processor.vocab_size, DRAFT_VOCAB_SIZE)
+        self.assertFalse(model.load_lm_head_from_target)
+
+    def test_reduced_vocab_with_untied_embedding(self):
+        model = self._build(
+            tie_word_embeddings=False, draft_vocab_size=DRAFT_VOCAB_SIZE
+        )
+        self.assertIsNot(model.lm_head, model.model.embed_tokens)
+        self.assertEqual(model.lm_head.weight.shape[0], DRAFT_VOCAB_SIZE)
+        self.assertEqual(model.logits_processor.vocab_size, DRAFT_VOCAB_SIZE)
+        self.assertFalse(model.load_lm_head_from_target)
+
+    def test_tied_embedding_without_draft_vocab_is_unchanged(self):
+        model = self._build(tie_word_embeddings=True)
+        self.assertIs(model.lm_head, model.model.embed_tokens)
+        self.assertEqual(model.logits_processor.vocab_size, VOCAB_SIZE)
+        self.assertFalse(model.load_lm_head_from_target)
+
+    def test_untied_embedding_without_draft_vocab_loads_from_target(self):
+        model = self._build(tie_word_embeddings=False)
+        self.assertIsNot(model.lm_head, model.model.embed_tokens)
+        self.assertEqual(model.lm_head.weight.shape[0], VOCAB_SIZE)
+        self.assertEqual(model.logits_processor.vocab_size, VOCAB_SIZE)
+        self.assertTrue(model.load_lm_head_from_target)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
